readerTheme.reason: 故事围绕小老鼠找家、借宿和睡觉做梦展开，场景在狗窝、鹦鹉、鱼缸与书架间变换，没有单一的冬季、农场或海洋主线，温馨睡前故事最适合中性的绘本花园。

Mouse walks through a purple night landscape toward a little house.
pages.enText: Mouse was looking for a new house.

pages.alt: Mouse peeks into a tall wooden doorway.
pages.enText: This looks like a nice house.
pages.zhText: 这里看起来是个不错的家。

sentences.translationZh: 这里看起来是个不错的家。

pages.alt: A big black puppy talks to Mouse.
pages.enText: “You can come and sleep with me,” said Puppy. “Thank you,” said Mouse.
pages.zhText: “你可以来和我一起睡。”小狗说。“谢谢你。”小老鼠说。
